item.title: Antivirus Interference: Resolving Development Environment Blocks
item.description:
“Antivirus Interference: Resolving Development Environment Blocks”

When encountering perplexing errors within a development workflow, especially involving tools like Visual Studio 2015, external software interference often warrants investigation. A recurring pattern suggests that certain antivirus suites can inadvertently cause issues for developers.

Is Avast Antivirus Suspected in Blocking Development Processes?

If you are experiencing unexplained build failures, execution halts, or access denials while working within environments such as Visual Studio 2015 projects, the presence of Avast antivirus software should be considered a prime suspect. This problem has surfaced in numerous recent reports across developer forums.
